description: Resource Type definition for AWS::SSM::DefaultHostManagementConfiguration. Enables or disables Default Host Management Configuration (DHMC) for an AWS account and Region by managing the '/ssm/managed-instance/default-ec2-instance-management-role' service setting. This is a singleton resource - there is at most one DHMC configuration per account/Region.

DHMCPermissionModel.description: The permission model used to enable DHMC. SERVICE_MANAGED lets SSM create and manage the DHMC IAM role on your behalf. SELF_MANAGED registers an IAM role that you provide.
DHMCPermissionModel.markdownDescription:
The permission model used to enable DHMC. SERVICE_MANAGED lets SSM create and manage the DHMC IAM role on your behalf. SELF_MANAGED registers an IAM role that you provide.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Allowed Values: SERVICE_MANAGED | SELF_MANAGED  
Update requires: No interruption

CustomerManagedRoleArn.description: The ARN of the customer-provided IAM role to register for DHMC. Required when PermissionModel is SELF_MANAGED and must not be set when PermissionModel is SERVICE_MANAGED.
CustomerManagedRoleArn.markdownDescription:
The ARN of the customer-provided IAM role to register for DHMC. Required when PermissionModel is SELF_MANAGED and must not be set when PermissionModel is SERVICE_MANAGED.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Minimum Length: 20  
Maximum Length: 2048  
Pattern: ^arn:(aws|aws-cn|aws-us-gov):iam::\d{12}:role/[\w+=,.@/-]+$  
Update requires: No interruption

RoleArn.description: The ARN of the IAM role currently configured for DHMC. For SERVICE_MANAGED this is the SSM-created role in the IAM reserved path; for SELF_MANAGED this echoes the registered CustomerManagedRoleArn.
RoleArn.markdownDescription:
The ARN of the IAM role currently configured for DHMC. For SERVICE_MANAGED this is the SSM-created role in the IAM reserved path; for SELF_MANAGED this echoes the registered CustomerManagedRoleArn.
